Recovery experiment and partial repair — 2026-10-07

Independent nine-start dense/QR reference on 16 matched B0 voxels at noise ratios 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2 proves noiseless recovery and separates search defects from weak-signal behavior. Source/evidence: docs/verification/phrf-recovery-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on ff4dd39f. All 80 reference energies agree with the portable banded objective. This is prepared-basis, condition-constant trial signal evidence, not original-family or random-effects calibration.

Retained opt-in DecodeInitialization.ChartCenterProbe charges one full jet/candidate when available and better under the data-plus-prior criterion. Default BankNode and default numerical budgets remain unchanged; provenance is explicitly decode-budget/v2 for both policies. With the same diagnostic 16-step/20-jet/40-exact/12-attempt budget and 1e-6 stationarity tolerance, eight-node bank-only accepts 0/16 at every noise level; center probe accepts 16,15,15,8,2. The independent reference has 16,16,15,10,3 interior stationary positive-curvature solutions and 0,0,1,6,13 boundary-preferred solutions. These budgets are not an accepted frozen B0 amendment.

Remaining concrete search failures: ratio 0.1 voxel 10 refuses curvature despite an interior reference solution (energy 1.8835732663 vs 1.7900486410). Ratio 1 voxel 3 is locally Accepted at a worse minimum than the boundary reference (3.9292657532 vs 3.9263841234; shape difference 0.3364 chart widths). Local Accepted does not establish best-solution selection. More bank nodes, nine interior probes and curvature-guarded backtracking did not resolve the strong-signal counterexample; the latter two were removed from production and archived as rejected experiments.

Validation: full fitJVM 689/689, full fitJS 632/632; 15 recovery/public-readout/workflow tests on each platform; packet verifies 53 source/artifact hashes, exact archived inputs and all 80 reference/candidate records. All 16 noiseless public outputs are off-node and consumed with Float32 conversion in the shared test. Receipts retain refused attempts and charged work. Small diagnostic execution times are not qualifying throughput.

Next bounded work: repair refinement and selection against the two concrete counterexamples while preserving budgets/terminal semantics (generic optimization belongs in Gale); specify weak/boundary scientific behavior; complete bounded N=1200 lowering and PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; only then execute full B0/stress performance gates and make the PHRF-33 activation/engineering decision. PHRF-33 remains OPEN/NOT ADMITTED. PHRF-14/15/16 remain open; finite-state work remains deferred. No acceptance criterion is relaxed.
